parties.respondent: Gangaram Sakharam Dhuri (D) Thr. LRs And Ors.

summary: Property dispute over C.T.S. No.1048; administration suit challenging sale deed validity; relinquishment deed unproved; trial court declared 1969 sale null and void; high court reversed holding 1/6 share sale binding; issue: whether misjoinder; standard: proof of relinquishment deed; reasoning: unregistered document requiring registration; disposition: appeal allowed, high court judgment set aside, trial decree restored.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court decree declaring Sale Deed dated 10.01.1969 null and void restored.
